# Embedded Emissions for Pig Iron (CN 7201) from India

**Embedded emissions: 1,266.27 tCO2e**

## Inputs

| Input | Value | In the table? |
|---|---|---|
| CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | Yes |
| Country of production | India | Yes, listed for 7201 |
| Quantity | 500.5 t | Provided |

All required inputs are present.

## Factor

The default SEE for CN 7201 produced in India is **2.53 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 500.5 t
= 1,266.265 tCO2e

Rounded half up to 2 decimal places, the result is **1,266.27 tCO2e**.
